```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(osmdata)
library(osmextract)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(units)
library(lwgeom)

votes <- read.csv("data/resultats-detailles-2025.csv")

votes <- votes %>% 
  filter(Poste == "0,00") 

votes <- votes %>% 
  mutate(CODE_SECT = paste0(ifelse(str_length(ElectoralDistrictID) > 2, ElectoralDistrictID, paste0("0", ElectoralDistrictID)), "-", Bureau))

votes <- votes %>% 
  mutate(`Candidate and Party` = paste0(Candidat, " ", Partie))

votes_candidate <- votes %>% 
  select(Votes, TotalValidVotes, CODE_SECT, `Candidate and Party`, District) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Candidate and Party`, values_from = Votes, id_cols = CODE_SECT)


votes_candidate <- votes %>% 
  distinct(CODE_SECT, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  
  select(CODE_SECT, TotalValidVotes, District)  %>% 
  left_join(., votes_candidate, by = "CODE_SECT")

votes_candidate <- votes_candidate %>% 
mutate(across(`DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`, \(x)round((x / TotalValidVotes)*100)))

winner <- votes_candidate %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`),
               names_to = "Canadidate and Party",
               values_to = "Percentage") %>% 
  group_by(CODE_SECT) %>% 
  slice_max(order_by = Percentage, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  
  ungroup()

winner <- votes_candidate %>% 
  select(CODE_SECT, `DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`) %>% 
  left_join(winner, .,  by = "CODE_SECT")

winner <- winner %>% 
  mutate(across(`DUVAL Jean Indépendant`:`SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé`, \(x)paste0(x, "%")))


winner <- winner %>% 
  mutate(`Canadidate and Party` = replace(`Canadidate and Party`, TotalValidVotes == 0, NA),
        `Canadidate and Party` = case_match(`Canadidate and Party`, 
                                             "RABOUIN Luc Projet Montréal - Équipe Luc Rabouin" ~ "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin",
                                             "MARTINEZ FERRADA Soraya Ensemble Montréal - Équipe Soraya" ~ "Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada",
                                             "THIBODEAU Gilbert Action Montréal - Équipe Gilbert Thibodeau" ~ "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau",
                                             "DUVAL Jean Indépendant" ~ "Indépendant: Jean Duval",
                                             "SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé" ~ "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé",
                                             "KACOU Jean-François Futur Montréal" ~ "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou",
                                             "LE ROUGETEL Katy Indépendant" ~ "Idépendant: Katy Le Rougetel"
                                             ))


winner <- winner %>% 
  rename( "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin" = "RABOUIN Luc Projet Montréal - Équipe Luc Rabouin",
           "Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada" = "MARTINEZ FERRADA Soraya Ensemble Montréal - Équipe Soraya",
           "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau" = "THIBODEAU Gilbert Action Montréal - Équipe Gilbert Thibodeau",
           "Indépendant: Jean Duval" = "DUVAL Jean Indépendant",
           "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé" = "SAUVÉ Craig Transition Montréal - Équipe Craig Sauvé",
           "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou" = "KACOU Jean-François Futur Montréal",
          "Idépendant: Katy Le Rougetel" = "LE ROUGETEL Katy Indépendant")

test <- winner %>% 
  filter(`Canadidate and Party` == "Indépendant: Jean Duval")

shp <- st_read("data/section-vote-2025/section-vote-2025.shp")

votes_candidate <- shp %>% 
  left_join(votes_candidate, by = "CODE_SECT")

shp <- shp %>% 
  left_join(winner, by = "CODE_SECT")
shp <- shp %>% 
  mutate(`Canadidate and Party` = replace(`Canadidate and Party`, is.na(`Canadidate and Party`), "No Votes"))
```


```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(cancensus)
csd_codes <- c(
  "2466023", "2466007", "2466032", "2466047", "2466058",
  "2466062", "2466072", "2466087", "2466092", "2466097",
  "2466102", "2466107", "2466112", "2466117", "2466127", "2466142"
)
# Montreal CSD (Census Subdivision)
mtl_csd <- get_census(
  dataset = "CA21",
  regions = list(CSD = csd_codes),  # Montreal city
  level = "CSD",
  geo_format = "sf"
)

montreal_island <- st_union(mtl_csd$geometry)

cycleways_Montreal <- readRDS("data/cycleways_Montreal.rds")
bike_lanes <- readRDS("data/bike_lanes.rds")

cycleways_Montreal = cycleways_Montreal %>% 
  mutate(
    tags_list = str_split(other_tags, ',') %>%
      map(~str_replace_all(.x, '"', '')) %>%
      map(~str_trim(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tags_kv = map(tags_list, ~setNames(
      str_extract(.x, '(?<==>).*'),
      str_extract(.x, '^[^=]+')
    ))
  )
cycleways_Montreal <- cycleways_Montreal %>% 
  mutate(
    cycleway       = map_chr(tags_kv, ~.x["cycleway"] %||% NA_character_),
    cycleway_left  = map_chr(tags_kv, ~.x["cycleway:left"] %||% NA_character_),
    cycleway_right = map_chr(tags_kv, ~.x["cycleway:right"] %||% NA_character_)
  )

bike <- cycleways_Montreal# %>%
  # filter(
  #   highway == "cycleway" |
  #     cycleway %in% c("lane","track") |
  #     cycleway_left %in% c("lane","track") |
  #     cycleway_right %in% c("lane","track")
  # )

bike <- st_transform(bike, st_crs(montreal_island))

bike_mtl <- st_intersection(bike, montreal_island)

bike_lanes <- st_transform(bike_lanes, st_crs(montreal_island))

bike_lanes_mtl <- st_intersection(bike_lanes, montreal_island)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# On-street parking spots, estimated in parking_spots.R

parking <- readRDS("data/parking_spots.rds") %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(shp))

# Assign each curb stretch (by a point on it) and paid spot to a polling district
parking_district <- parking %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_join(shp %>% select(CODE_SECT), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(CODE_SECT)) %>%
  group_by(CODE_SECT) %>%
  summarise(
    free_spots = sum(n_spots[parking_type == "Free"]),
    permit_spots = sum(n_spots[parking_type == "Permit"]),
    paid_spots = sum(n_spots[parking_type == "Paid"]),
    # Share of the district's curbs in boroughs without a complete sign inventory
    no_sign_data = sum(usable_length[parking_type == "No sign data"]) /
      sum(usable_length[parking_type != "Paid"])
  )

shp <- shp %>%
  left_join(parking_district, by = "CODE_SECT") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(free_spots, permit_spots, paid_spots), \(x) replace_na(x, 0)),
    no_sign_data = replace_na(no_sign_data, 0),
    parking_summary = ifelse(
      no_sign_data > 0.5,
      paste0("Free: <span style='color:#999'>no sign data for this borough</span><br>",
             "Permit: <span style='color:#999'>no sign data for this borough</span><br>"),
      paste0("Free: <strong>", format(free_spots, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "</strong><br>",
             "Permit: <strong>", format(permit_spots, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "</strong><br>")
    ),
    parking_summary = paste0(parking_summary,
                             "Paid: <strong>", format(paid_spots, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "</strong>")
  )

parking <- parking %>%
  filter(parking_type != "No sign data") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

```


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

shp_proj <- st_transform(shp, 3857)
bike_proj <- st_transform(bike_mtl, 3857)
green_lanes <- st_transform(green_lanes, 3857)
bike_proj <- st_cast(bike_proj, "LINESTRING")

# Unbuffered district outlines, kept for drawing the map
district_outlines <- st_geometry(shp_proj)

# Small buffer around each district to capture lines along boundaries
shp_buffered <- st_buffer(shp_proj, 1)  # 1 meter buffer

# Compute bike length per district
shp_proj <- shp_buffered %>%
  mutate(
    bike_summary = map_chr(seq_len(nrow(shp_buffered)), function(j) {
      district_geom <- shp_buffered[j, ]
      
      # Select lines that intersect this district (buffered)
      hits <- st_intersects(bike_proj, district_geom, sparse = FALSE)
      lines_in_district <- bike_proj[hits[,1], ]
      
      if (nrow(lines_in_district) == 0) {
        return("<span style='color:#999'>0 km</span>")
      }
      
      # Clip the lines to the polygon
      clipped <- st_intersection(lines_in_district, district_geom)
      
      # Convert lengths to numeric before summing
      lengths <- as.numeric(st_length(clipped))  # <- important fix
      total_km <- sum(lengths) / 1000
      
      display_km <- ifelse(total_km < 0.01, "< 0.01", round(total_km, 2))
      paste0("<strong>", display_km, " km of bike lanes</strong>")
    })
  )

# Flag whether each district contains a green lane
shp_proj <- shp_proj %>%
  mutate(
    green_summary = ifelse(
      lengths(st_intersects(shp_proj, green_lanes)) > 0,
      "<strong>Yes</strong>",
      "<span style='color:#999'>No</span>"
    )
  )

shp <- shp_proj %>%
  mutate(
    popup_base = paste0(
      "<b>District:</b> ", District, "<br>",
      "<b>Polling Station:</b> ", CODE_SECT, "<br>",
      "<b>Winner:</b> ", `Canadidate and Party`, "<br>",
      "<b>Indépendant - Jean Duval:</b> ", `Indépendant: Jean Duval`, "<br>",
      "<b>Futur Montréal - Jean-François Kacou:</b> ", `Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou`, "<br>",
      "<b>Ensemble Montréal - Soraya Martinez Ferrada:</b> ", `Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada`, "<br>",
      "<b>Projet Montréal - Luc Rabouin:</b> ", `Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin`, "<br>",
      "<b>Idépendant: Katy - Le Rougetel:</b> ", `Idépendant: Katy Le Rougetel`, "<br>",
      "<b>Transition Montréal - Craig Sauvé:</b> ", `Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé`, "<br>",
      "<b>Action Montréal - Gilbert Thibodeau:</b> ", `Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau`, "<br>"
      
    ),

    # Sections appended to popup_base in onRender depending on active layers
    popup_bike = paste0(
      "<hr>",
      "<strong>🚲 Bike lanes</strong><br>",
      bike_summary
     ),

    popup_green = paste0(
      "<hr>",
      "<strong>🌿 Green lane in district</strong><br>",
      green_summary
     ),

    popup_parking = paste0(
      "<hr>",
      "<strong>🅿️ On-street parking spots (est.)</strong><br>",
      parking_summary
     )#,
    # 
    # popup_demo = paste0(
    #   popup_base,
    #   "<hr>",
    #   "<strong>👥 Demographics</strong><br>",
    #   "Population: ", population, "<br>",
    #   "Median income: ", income
    # )
  )


shp <- shp %>% 
  mutate(`Canadidate and Party` = factor(`Canadidate and Party`,
                                         levels = c("Ensemble Montréal: Soraya Martinez Ferrada",
                                                    "Projet Montréal: Luc Rabouin",
                                                    "Transition Montréal: Craig Sauvé",
                                                     "Futur Montréal: Jean-François Kacou",
                                                    "Action Montréal: Gilbert Thibodeau",
                                                    "Idépendant: Katy Le Rougetel",
                                                    "Indépendant: Jean Duval",
                                                    "No Votes"
          )))

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("yellow3", "hotpink", "#3a9694", "darkblue", "#ff4f19", "grey30"),
  domain = shp$`Canadidate and Party`
)

pal_parking <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#00e5ff", "#ffd700", "#ff00ff"),
  domain = c("Free", "Permit", "Paid")
)

# pal_bike <- colorFactor(
#   domain = bike_lanes_mtl$cycleway,
#   palette = c("green", "blue", "orange", "red", "white")
# )
bike_proj <- st_transform(bike_proj, crs = 4326)
green_lanes <- st_transform(green_lanes, crs = 4326)
shp_proj <- st_transform(shp_proj, crs = 4326)

# Keep the page small: draw simplified district outlines (shared borders stay
# aligned) and round all coordinates to 5 decimals (~1 m)
st_geometry(shp_proj) <- district_outlines %>%
  rmapshaper::ms_simplify(keep = 0.2, keep_shapes = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

round_coords <- function(x) {
  st_geometry(x) <- st_geometry(x) %>%
    st_set_precision(1e5) %>%
    st_as_binary() %>%
    st_as_sfc(crs = 4326)
  x
}

shp_proj <- round_coords(shp_proj)
bike_proj <- round_coords(bike_proj)
green_lanes <- round_coords(green_lanes)
parking <- round_coords(parking)

  
election_map <- leaflet(shp_proj) |>
  addTiles() |>
    addFullscreenControl() |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(`Canadidate and Party`),
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    label = ~paste(`Canadidate and Party`),
    popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
    options = pathOptions(
      popup_base = shp$popup_base,
      popup_bike = shp$popup_bike,
      popup_green = shp$popup_green,
      popup_parking = shp$popup_parking,
      #popup_demo = districts$popup_demo
    ),
    group = "Electoral Districts"
  ) |>
  #    addPolylines(
  #   data = bike_mtl,
  #   color = "darkgreen",
  #   weight = 2,
  #   opacity = 0.9,
  #   group = "Bike Lanes"
  # ) |>
    addPolylines(
    data = bike_proj,
    color = "white",
    #label = ~paste(cycleway),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    group = "Bike Lanes"
  ) |>
    addPolygons(
    data = green_lanes,
    color = "green",
    fillColor = "green",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste("Open to traffic:", Open_to_traffic),
    group = "Green Lanes"
  ) |>
    addPolylines(
    data = filter(parking, parking_type == "Free"),
    color = pal_parking("Free"),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste0("Free: ", n_spots, " spots"),
    group = "Parking"
  ) |>
    addPolylines(
    data = filter(parking, parking_type == "Permit"),
    color = pal_parking("Permit"),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste0("Permit: ", n_spots, " spots"),
    group = "Parking"
  ) |>
    addCircleMarkers(
    data = filter(parking, parking_type == "Paid"),
    color = pal_parking("Paid"),
    radius = 2,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = "Paid: 1 spot",
    group = "Parking"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~`Canadidate and Party`,
    title = "Party"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomleft",
    pal = pal_parking,
    values = c("Free", "Permit", "Paid"),
    title = "Parking",
    group = "Parking"
  ) %>%
   addLayersControl(
     overlayGroups = c("Electoral Districts", "Bike Lanes", "Green Lanes", "Parking"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
   hideGroup(c(
    "Bike Lanes",
    "Green Lanes",
    "Parking"
  )) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;

      // Popup sections to show for each overlay
      var sections = {
        'Bike Lanes': 'popup_bike',
        'Green Lanes': 'popup_green',
        'Parking': 'popup_parking',
        'Demographics': 'popup_demo'
      };
      var active = {};

      function updatePopups() {
        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          if (layer.options && layer.options.popup_base) {
            var html = layer.options.popup_base;
            Object.keys(sections).forEach(function(name) {
              if (active[name] && layer.options[sections[name]]) {
                html += layer.options[sections[name]];
              }
            });
            layer.bindPopup(html, { closeOnClick: false });
          }
        });
      }

      map.on('overlayadd', function(e) {
        active[e.name] = true;
        updatePopups();
      });

      map.on('overlayremove', function(e) {
        active[e.name] = false;
        updatePopups();
      });

      updatePopups();
    }
  ")

# Write at most 5 decimals to the page (coordinates are already rounded)
attr(election_map$x, "TOJSON_ARGS") <- list(digits = 5, use_signif = FALSE)
election_map
```
